decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith (5280/01, 02, 03, 04, 05, 06, 07, 08 and 09 received 06.08.12. Travel Plan received 09.11.12.) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - Prior to the use of the extensions hereby approved, trees shall be planted within the school site as replacements for the two trees removed following construction of the development hereby approved.

Condition : 5 - The submitted travel plan shall be implemented following first use of the development hereby approved and continued as approved unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of four single storey extensions to the front, side and rear of the bulding to create a new main entrance, two additional classrooms and storage space and increase the size of four existing classrooms.
